ko.title: 범죄, 생계비, 그리고 양극화된 유권자층: 일요일 브라질 대선에서 주목해야 할 점

segments.src: Brazilians head to the polls on Sunday, October 4, in national elections that will decide the presidency, seats in Congress and many state governorships.
segments.tr: 브라질 유권자들은 대통령, 의회 의원, 그리고 다수의 주지사를 선출하는 전국 선거를 위해 10월 4일 일요일에 투표소로 향합니다.

segments.src: Public safety sits near the top of voters' concerns in recent polling, alongside the cost of living and a deeply divided political climate.
segments.tr: 공공 안전은 생활비 및 심각하게 분열된 정치적 분위기와 함께 최근 여론조사에서 유권자들의 주요 관심사 중 상위에 올라 있습니다.

segments.src: For Latin America's largest economy, the outcome will shape policy for the next four years, and the effects will reach well beyond its borders.
segments.tr: 라틴 아메리카 최대 경제국인 이번 선거의 결과는 향후 4년간의 정책을 결정할 것이며, 그 영향은 국경을 훨씬 넘어 미칠 것입니다.

segments.src: *This article is a general overview for readers.
segments.tr: *이 기사는 독자들을 위한 일반적인 개요입니다.

segments.src: Check official sources and reputable news outlets for the latest candidate lists, polling and results.*
segments.tr: 최신 후보자 명단, 여론조사 및 결과는 공식 출처와 공신력 있는 뉴스 매체를 확인하세요.*

segments.src: ## How the vote works
segments.tr: ## 투표 방식

segments.src: Brazil uses a two-round system for the presidency.
segments.tr: 브라질은 대통령 선거에 결선투표제를 사용합니다.

segments.src: If no candidate wins more than half of the valid votes on Sunday, the top two finishers advance to a runoff, which is traditionally held about four weeks later.
segments.tr: 일요일 투표에서 과반수의 유효 투표를 얻은 후보가 없으면, 상위 2명의 후보가 결선투표에 진출하며, 이는 전통적으로 약 4주 후에 개최됩니다.

segments.src: Voting is compulsory for most adults, so turnout is typically high.
segments.tr: 대부분의 성인에게 투표는 의무이므로 투표율은 보통 높습니다.

segments.src: Votes are cast on electronic voting machines, and results usually come in quickly on election night.
segments.tr: 투표는 전자투표기로 이루어지며, 결과는 보통 선거일 밤에 빠르게 집계됩니다.

segments.src: Voters are also choosing members of the Chamber of Deputies, a portion of the Senate, state governors and state legislators.
segments.tr: 유권자들은 또한 하원 의원, 상원의 일부, 주지사 및 주 의원을 선출하고 있습니다.

segments.src: The makeup of Congress matters almost as much as the presidency, because a president needs legislative support to pass budgets, tax changes and reforms.
segments.tr: 의회의 구성은 대통령직 못지않게 중요한데, 대통령이 예산, 세제 개편 및 개혁을 통과시키려면 입법부의 지원이 필요하기 때문입니다.

segments.src: ## The issues driving the race
segments.tr: ## 선거전을 주도하는 쟁점들

segments.src: ### Public safety
segments.tr: ### 공공 안전

segments.src: Concerns about crime, organized criminal groups and violence have become central to the campaign.
segments.tr: 범죄, 조직 범죄 집단, 폭력에 대한 우려가 선거전의 핵심 이슈가 되었습니다.

segments.src: Voters in many large cities and in several regions report worries about armed gangs, drug trafficking and theft.
segments.tr: 많은 대도시와 여러 지역의 유권자들은 무장 갱단, 마약 밀매, 절도에 대한 우려를 표하고 있습니다.

segments.src: Candidates have offered different answers, from tougher policing and sentencing to investment in intelligence, prisons, border control and social programs.
segments.tr: 후보들은 더 엄격한 치안 및 처벌부터 정보력, 교도소, 국경 통제, 사회 프로그램에 대한 투자에 이르기까지 다양한 해법을 제시해 왔습니다.

segments.src: Public safety is largely a state responsibility in Brazil, which means governors' races carry real weight on this issue, even as presidential candidates debate national strategy.
segments.tr: 브라질에서 공공 안전은 주로 주의 책임이므로, 대통령 후보들이 국가 전략을 논의하는 동안에도 주지사 선거는 이 문제에 있어 실질적인 무게를 갖습니다.

segments.src: ### Cost of living
segments.tr: ### 생계비

segments.src: Prices for food, housing, energy and transportation remain a daily concern for many households.
segments.tr: 식품, 주거, 에너지, 운송 가격은 많은 가정에 여전히 일상적인 관심사입니다.

segments.src: Interest rates have been high as the central bank has worked to keep inflation in check, which raises borrowing costs for families and businesses.
segments.tr: 중앙은행이 인플레이션을 억제하기 위해 노력함에 따라 금리가 높게 유지되어, 가정과 기업의 차입 비용이 증가했습니다.

segments.src: Voters are weighing which candidates seem most likely to protect purchasing power, create jobs and manage public spending responsibly.
segments.tr: 유권자들은 어떤 후보가 구매력을 보호하고, 일자리를 창출하며, 공공 지출을 책임감 있게 관리할 가능성이 가장 높은지 저울질하고 있습니다.

segments.src: ### Fiscal policy and the economy
segments.tr: ### 재정 정책과 경제

segments.src: Investors are watching how the next government plans to handle public debt, spending limits and tax reform.
segments.tr: 투자자들은 차기 정부가 공공 부채, 지출 한도, 세제 개편을 어떻게 처리할 계획인지 주시하고 있습니다.

segments.src: Markets in Brazil have often reacted strongly to signals about fiscal discipline, and the currency, the real, can swing with political news.
segments.tr: 브라질 시장은 재정 규율에 대한 신호에 강하게 반응하는 경우가 많았으며, 통화인 헤알화는 정치적 뉴스에 따라 크게 흔들릴 수 있습니다.

segments.src: Any shift in approach to spending, social programs or state-owned companies could influence growth, inflation and investor confidence.
segments.tr: 지출, 사회 프로그램 또는 국영 기업에 대한 접근 방식의 변화는 성장, 인플레이션, 투자자 신뢰에 영향을 미칠 수 있습니다.

segments.src: ### A polarized electorate
segments.tr: ### 양극화된 유권자층

segments.src: Brazilian politics has been sharply divided for years, with strong loyalties on both the left and the right.
segments.tr: 브라질 정치는 수년 동안 좌파와 우파 모두에 대한 강한 충성심과 함께 극도로 분열되어 왔습니다.

segments.src: Campaigns have been marked by heated rhetoric, intense social media activity and concerns about misinformation.
segments.tr: 선거전은 과열된 수사, 격렬한 소셜 미디어 활동, 허위 정보에 대한 우려로 특징지어졌습니다.

segments.src: Many analysts note that a sizable group of undecided or less-committed voters could decide close contests, and that a runoff is a real possibility.
segments.tr: 많은 분석가들은 상당수의 부동층 또는 지지가 확고하지 않은 유권자들이 박빙의 승부를 결정지을 수 있으며, 결선투표의 가능성이 충분하다고 지적합니다.

segments.src: ## Why it matters for the region
segments.tr: ## 지역에 중요한 이유

segments.src: Brazil is the largest economy in Latin America and a major producer of agricultural goods, iron ore, oil and other commodities.
segments.tr: 브라질은 라틴 아메리카 최대 경제국이자 농산물, 철광석, 석유 및 기타 원자재의 주요 생산국입니다.

segments.src: It plays a leading role in regional diplomacy and in global discussions on trade and climate.
segments.tr: 이 나라는 지역 외교 및 무역과 기후에 관한 글로벌 논의에서 주도적인 역할을 합니다.

segments.src: Its policy choices affect neighbors' trade, investment flows and regional cooperation, and its stability influences how international investors view emerging markets more broadly.
segments.tr: 브라질의 정책 선택은 이웃 국가의 무역, 투자 흐름, 지역 협력에 영향을 미치며, 그 안정성은 국제 투자자들이 신흥 시장을 더 넓게 바라보는 시각에 영향을 줍니다.

segments.src: ## What U.S. readers should watch
segments.tr: ## 미국 독자들이 주목해야 할 점

segments.src: - **Whether there is a runoff.** If no one clears 50 percent on Sunday, the race continues for several more weeks, and uncertainty may linger.
segments.tr: - **결선투표 여부.** 일요일에 과반수를 얻는 사람이 없다면, 경선은 몇 주 더 지속되고 불확실성이 지속될 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Congressional results.** A fragmented legislature can limit what any president is able to do.
segments.tr: - **의회 선거 결과.** 분열된 입법부는 대통령이 할 수 있는 일을 제한할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Market reaction.** Moves in the Brazilian real, local stocks and bond yields will signal how investors read the outcome.
segments.tr: - **시장 반응.** 브라질 헤알화, 지역 주식 및 채권 수익률의 움직임은 투자자들이 결과를 어떻게 읽고 있는지 신호를 보낼 것입니다.

segments.src: - **Trade and investment signals.** The U.S. and Brazil are major trading partners, and policy on tariffs, energy, agriculture and technology could shift depending on the winner.
segments.tr: - **무역 및 투자 신호.** 미국과 브라질은 주요 무역 파트너이며, 관세, 에너지, 농업, 기술에 관한 정책은 승자에 따라 바뀔 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Climate and the Amazon.** Brazil's approach to deforestation and environmental enforcement is closely followed by governments and companies worldwide.
segments.tr: - **기후와 아마존.** 산림 벌채와 환경 집행에 대한 브라질의 접근 방식은 전 세계 정부와 기업들의 면밀한 주시를 받고 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Acceptance of the result.** Observers will pay attention to how candidates, institutions and the public respond to the official count.
segments.tr: - **결과 승복.** 관측통들은 후보, 기관, 대중이 공식 집계에 어떻게 반응하는지 주목할 것입니다.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## 요약

segments.src: Safety and affordability are the issues voters say they feel most directly, and they are shaping how candidates present themselves.
segments.tr: 안전과 경제성은 유권자들이 가장 직접적으로 느낀다고 말하는 쟁점들이며, 이는 후보들이 자신을 어필하는 방식을 형성하고 있습니다.

segments.src: Whatever the result on Sunday, the next government will face pressure to deliver on both while managing a divided country and a cautious investment community.
segments.tr: 일요일의 결과가 무엇이든, 차기 정부는 분열된 국가와 신중한 투자 커뮤니티를 관리하는 동시에 두 가지 모두를 이뤄내야 하는 압박에 직면할 것입니다.

segments.src: For international readers, the key questions are whether the vote is decisive, how smoothly the transition unfolds, and what direction economic policy takes.
segments.tr: 국제 독자들에게 핵심 질문은 투표가 결정적이턴지 여부, 권력 이양이 얼마나 원활하게 이루어지는지, 경제 정책이 어떤 방향으로 나아가는지입니다.

zh.title: 犯罪、生活成本与两极分化的选民：巴西周日投票看点

segments.src: Brazilians head to the polls on Sunday, October 4, in national elections that will decide the presidency, seats in Congress and many state governorships.
segments.tr: 巴西人将于10月4日周日走向投票箱，参加将决定总统职位、国会议席以及许多州长职位的全国大选。

segments.src: Public safety sits near the top of voters' concerns in recent polling, alongside the cost of living and a deeply divided political climate.
segments.tr: 根据最近的民调，公共安全与生活成本以及深刻分裂的政治气候一起，位居选民关注焦点的最前沿。

segments.src: For Latin America's largest economy, the outcome will shape policy for the next four years, and the effects will reach well beyond its borders.
segments.tr: 对于拉丁美洲最大的经济体而言，选举结果将塑造未来四年的政策，其影响将远超国界。

segments.src: *This article is a general overview for readers.
segments.tr: *本文是为读者提供的通用概述。

segments.src: Check official sources and reputable news outlets for the latest candidate lists, polling and results.*
segments.tr: 请查看官方渠道和信誉良好的新闻媒体，了解最新的候选人名单、民调和结果*

segments.src: ## How the vote works
segments.tr: ## 投票如何运作

segments.src: Brazil uses a two-round system for the presidency.
segments.tr: 巴西对总统选举采用两轮制。

segments.src: If no candidate wins more than half of the valid votes on Sunday, the top two finishers advance to a runoff, which is traditionally held about four weeks later.
segments.tr: 如果在周日没有候选人赢得超过一半的有效选票，得票最多的两名候选人将进入决胜轮，该轮选举通常在约四周后举行。

segments.src: Voting is compulsory for most adults, so turnout is typically high.
segments.tr: 大多数成年人必须强制投票，因此投票率通常很高。

segments.src: Votes are cast on electronic voting machines, and results usually come in quickly on election night.
segments.tr: 选票是通过电子投票机投出的，选举之夜通常会很快公布结果。

segments.src: Voters are also choosing members of the Chamber of Deputies, a portion of the Senate, state governors and state legislators.
segments.tr: 选民还在选择众议院议员、部分参议员、州长和州议员。

segments.src: The makeup of Congress matters almost as much as the presidency, because a president needs legislative support to pass budgets, tax changes and reforms.
segments.tr: 国会的构成几乎与总统职位同样重要，因为总统需要立法支持来通过预算、税收变革和改革。

segments.src: ## The issues driving the race
segments.tr: ## 推动选战的议题

segments.src: ### Public safety
segments.tr: ### 公共安全

segments.src: Concerns about crime, organized criminal groups and violence have become central to the campaign.
segments.tr: 对犯罪、有组织犯罪集团和暴力的担忧已成为竞选的核心。

segments.src: Voters in many large cities and in several regions report worries about armed gangs, drug trafficking and theft.
segments.tr: 许多大城市和几个地区的选民报告了对武装团伙、贩毒和盗窃的担忧。

segments.src: Candidates have offered different answers, from tougher policing and sentencing to investment in intelligence, prisons, border control and social programs.
segments.tr: 候选人提出了不同的答案，从更严厉的警务和量刑到对情报、监狱、边境控制和社会项目的投资。

segments.src: Public safety is largely a state responsibility in Brazil, which means governors' races carry real weight on this issue, even as presidential candidates debate national strategy.
segments.tr: 在巴西，公共安全主要是一项州级责任，这意味着尽管总统候选人辩论国家战略，但州长竞选在这个议题上具有真正的分量。

segments.src: ### Cost of living
segments.tr: ### 生活成本

segments.src: Prices for food, housing, energy and transportation remain a daily concern for many households.
segments.tr: 食品、住房、能源和交通价格仍然是许多家庭日常关注的问题。

segments.src: Interest rates have been high as the central bank has worked to keep inflation in check, which raises borrowing costs for families and businesses.
segments.tr: 由于中央银行一直致力于控制通胀，利率一直很高，这增加了家庭和企业的借贷成本。

segments.src: Voters are weighing which candidates seem most likely to protect purchasing power, create jobs and manage public spending responsibly.
segments.tr: 选民正在权衡哪些候选人最有可能保护购买力、创造就业机会并负责任地管理公共支出。

segments.src: ### Fiscal policy and the economy
segments.tr: ### 财政政策与经济

segments.src: Investors are watching how the next government plans to handle public debt, spending limits and tax reform.
segments.tr: 投资者正在密切关注下一届政府计划如何处理公共债务、支出限额和税收改革。

segments.src: Markets in Brazil have often reacted strongly to signals about fiscal discipline, and the currency, the real, can swing with political news.
segments.tr: 巴西的市场历来对关于财政纪律的信号作出强烈反应，其货币雷亚尔会随政治新闻而波动。

segments.src: Any shift in approach to spending, social programs or state-owned companies could influence growth, inflation and investor confidence.
segments.tr: 在支出、社会项目或国有企业方法上的任何转变都可能影响增长、通胀和投资者信心。

segments.src: ### A polarized electorate
segments.tr: ### 两极分化的选民

segments.src: Brazilian politics has been sharply divided for years, with strong loyalties on both the left and the right.
segments.tr: 多年来，巴西政治一直存在严重分歧，左翼和右翼都有坚定的忠诚度。

segments.src: Campaigns have been marked by heated rhetoric, intense social media activity and concerns about misinformation.
segments.tr: 竞选活动的特点是激烈的言辞、密集的社交媒体活动以及对虚假信息的担忧。

segments.src: Many analysts note that a sizable group of undecided or less-committed voters could decide close contests, and that a runoff is a real possibility.
segments.tr: 许多分析人士指出，相当大一部分未决定或立场不太坚定的选民可能会决定势均力敌的竞选结果，并且决胜轮是完全有可能发生的。

segments.src: ## Why it matters for the region
segments.tr: ## 为什么这对该地区很重要

segments.src: Brazil is the largest economy in Latin America and a major producer of agricultural goods, iron ore, oil and other commodities.
segments.tr: 巴西是拉丁美洲最大的经济体，也是农产品、铁矿石、石油和其他大宗商品的主要生产国。

segments.src: It plays a leading role in regional diplomacy and in global discussions on trade and climate.
segments.tr: 它在地区外交以及关于贸易和气候的全球讨论中发挥着领导作用。

segments.src: Its policy choices affect neighbors' trade, investment flows and regional cooperation, and its stability influences how international investors view emerging markets more broadly.
segments.tr: 其政策选择影响着邻国的贸易、投资流向和区域合作，其稳定性影响着国际投资者对更广泛的新兴市场的看法。

segments.src: ## What U.S. readers should watch
segments.tr: ## 美国读者应关注什么

segments.src: - **Whether there is a runoff.** If no one clears 50 percent on Sunday, the race continues for several more weeks, and uncertainty may linger.
segments.tr: - **是否会进行决胜轮选举。** 如果周日没有人获得50%的选票，竞选将再持续几周，不确定性可能会挥之不去。

segments.src: - **Congressional results.** A fragmented legislature can limit what any president is able to do.

hi.title: अपराध, जीवन यापन की लागत और ध्रुवीकृत मतदाता: रविवार को ब्राजील में मतदान के दौरान क्या देखें

segments.src: Brazilians head to the polls on Sunday, October 4, in national elections that will decide the presidency, seats in Congress and many state governorships.
segments.tr: ब्राजील के नागरिक रविवार, 4 अक्टूबर को राष्ट्रीय चुनावों में मतदान करेंगे, जो राष्ट्रपति पद, कांग्रेस की सीटों और कई राज्य गवर्नरों के पदों का फैसला करेंगे।

segments.src: Public safety sits near the top of voters' concerns in recent polling, alongside the cost of living and a deeply divided political climate.
segments.tr: हाल के मतदान में सार्वजनिक सुरक्षा मतदाताओं की चिंताओं में सबसे ऊपर है, साथ ही जीवन यापन की लागत और गहराई से विभाजित राजनीतिक माहौल भी शामिल है।

segments.src: For Latin America's largest economy, the outcome will shape policy for the next four years, and the effects will reach well beyond its borders.
segments.tr: लैटिन अमेरिका की सबसे बड़ी अर्थव्यवस्था के लिए, परिणाम अगले चार वर्षों के लिए नीति को आकार देगा, और इसके प्रभाव इसकी सीमाओं से बहुत आगे तक पहुंचेंगे।

segments.src: *This article is a general overview for readers.
segments.tr: *यह लेख पाठकों के लिए एक सामान्य अवलोकन है।

segments.src: Check official sources and reputable news outlets for the latest candidate lists, polling and results.*
segments.tr: नवीनतम उम्मीदवार सूचियों, मतदान और परिणामों के लिए आधिकारिक स्रोतों और प्रतिष्ठित समाचार आउटलेट्स की जांच करें।*

segments.src: ## How the vote works
segments.tr: ## मतदान कैसे काम करता है

segments.src: Brazil uses a two-round system for the presidency.
segments.tr: ब्राजील राष्ट्रपति पद के लिए दो-चरण वाली प्रणाली का उपयोग करता है।

segments.src: If no candidate wins more than half of the valid votes on Sunday, the top two finishers advance to a runoff, which is traditionally held about four weeks later.
segments.tr: यदि कोई उम्मीदवार रविवार को वैध मतों के आधे से अधिक नहीं जीतता है, तो शीर्ष दो उम्मीदवार रनऑफ में आगे बढ़ते हैं, जो पारंपरिक रूप से लगभग चार सप्ताह बाद आयोजित किया जाता है।

segments.src: Voting is compulsory for most adults, so turnout is typically high.
segments.tr: अधिकांश वयस्कों के लिए मतदान अनिवार्य है, इसलिए मतदान प्रतिशत आमतौर पर अधिक होता है।

segments.src: Votes are cast on electronic voting machines, and results usually come in quickly on election night.
segments.tr: वोट इलेक्ट्रॉनिक वोटिंग मशीनों पर डाले जाते हैं, और चुनाव की रात परिणाम आमतौर पर जल्दी आ जाते हैं।

segments.src: Voters are also choosing members of the Chamber of Deputies, a portion of the Senate, state governors and state legislators.
segments.tr: मतदाता चैंबर ऑफ डेप्युटीज के सदस्यों, सीनेट के एक हिस्से, राज्य के गवर्नरों और राज्य के विधायकों को भी चुन रहे हैं।

segments.src: The makeup of Congress matters almost as much as the presidency, because a president needs legislative support to pass budgets, tax changes and reforms.
segments.tr: कांग्रेस की संरचना राष्ट्रपति पद जितनी ही महत्वपूर्ण है, क्योंकि राष्ट्रपति को बजट, कर परिवर्तनों और सुधारों को पारित करने के लिए विधायी समर्थन की आवश्यकता होती है।

segments.src: ## The issues driving the race
segments.tr: ## दौड़ को प्रेरित करने वाले मुद्दे

segments.src: ### Public safety
segments.tr: ### सार्वजनिक सुरक्षा

segments.src: Concerns about crime, organized criminal groups and violence have become central to the campaign.
segments.tr: अपराध, संगठित आपराधिक समूहों और हिंसा के बारे में चिंताएं अभियान के केंद्र में आ गई हैं।

segments.src: Voters in many large cities and in several regions report worries about armed gangs, drug trafficking and theft.
segments.tr: कई बड़े शहरों और कई क्षेत्रों में मतदाता सशस्त्र गिरोहों, नशीली दवाओं की तस्करी और चोरी के बारे में चिंता व्यक्त करते हैं।

segments.src: Candidates have offered different answers, from tougher policing and sentencing to investment in intelligence, prisons, border control and social programs.
segments.tr: उम्मीदवारों ने अलग-अलग उत्तर दिए हैं, सख्त पुलिसिंग और सजा से लेकर खुफिया जानकारी, जेलों, सीमा नियंत्रण और सामाजिक कार्यक्रमों में निवेश तक।

segments.src: Public safety is largely a state responsibility in Brazil, which means governors' races carry real weight on this issue, even as presidential candidates debate national strategy.
segments.tr: ब्राजील में सार्वजनिक सुरक्षा काफी हद तक राज्य की जिम्मेदारी है, जिसका अर्थ है कि गवर्नरों की दौड़ का इस मुद्दे पर वास्तविक महत्व है, भले ही राष्ट्रपति पद के उम्मीदवार राष्ट्रीय रणनीति पर बहस कर रहे हों।

segments.src: ### Cost of living
segments.tr: ### जीवन यापन की लागत

segments.src: Prices for food, housing, energy and transportation remain a daily concern for many households.
segments.tr: भोजन, आवास, ऊर्जा और परिवहन की कीमतें कई परिवारों के लिए दैनिक चिंता का विषय बनी हुई हैं।

segments.src: Interest rates have been high as the central bank has worked to keep inflation in check, which raises borrowing costs for families and businesses.
segments.tr: ब्याज दरें अधिक रही हैं क्योंकि केंद्रीय बैंक ने मुद्रास्फीति को नियंत्रण में रखने के लिए काम किया है, जिससे परिवारों और व्यवसायों के लिए उधार लेने की लागत बढ़ जाती है।

segments.src: Voters are weighing which candidates seem most likely to protect purchasing power, create jobs and manage public spending responsibly.
segments.tr: मतदाता यह तौल रहे हैं कि कौन से उम्मीदवार क्रय शक्ति की रक्षा करने, नौकरियां पैदा करने और सार्वजनिक खर्च का जिम्मेदारी से प्रबंधन करने की सबसे अधिक संभावना रखते हैं।

segments.src: ### Fiscal policy and the economy
segments.tr: ### राजकोषीय नीति और अर्थव्यवस्था

segments.src: Investors are watching how the next government plans to handle public debt, spending limits and tax reform.
segments.tr: निवेशक यह देख रहे हैं कि अगली सरकार सार्वजनिक ऋण, खर्च की सीमा और कर सुधार को कैसे संभालने की योजना बना रही है।

segments.src: Markets in Brazil have often reacted strongly to signals about fiscal discipline, and the currency, the real, can swing with political news.
segments.tr: ब्राजील के बाजारों ने अक्सर राजकोषीय अनुशासन के संकेतों पर कड़ी प्रतिक्रिया दी है, और मुद्रा, रियल, राजनीतिक समाचारों के साथ बदल सकती है।

segments.src: Any shift in approach to spending, social programs or state-owned companies could influence growth, inflation and investor confidence.
segments.tr: खर्च, सामाजिक कार्यक्रमों या राज्य के स्वामित्व वाली कंपनियों के प्रति दृष्टिकोण में कोई भी बदलाव विकास, मुद्रास्फीति और निवेशकों के विश्वास को प्रभावित कर सकता है।

segments.src: ### A polarized electorate
segments.tr: ### एक ध्रुवीकृत मतदाता

segments.src: Brazilian politics has been sharply divided for years, with strong loyalties on both the left and the right.
segments.tr: ब्राजील की राजनीति वर्षों से स्पष्ट रूप से विभाजित है, जिसमें वाम और दक्षिण दोनों तरफ मजबूत निष्ठाएं हैं।

segments.src: Campaigns have been marked by heated rhetoric, intense social media activity and concerns about misinformation.
segments.tr: अभियान तीखे बयानबाजी, गहन सोशल मीडिया गतिविधि और गलत सूचनाओं के बारे में चिंताओं से चिह्नित रहे हैं।

segments.src: Many analysts note that a sizable group of undecided or less-committed voters could decide close contests, and that a runoff is a real possibility.
segments.tr: कई विश्लेषकों का कहना है कि अनिर्णीत या कम प्रतिबद्ध मतदाताओं का एक बड़ा समूह करीबी मुकाबलों का फैसला कर सकता है, और यह कि रनऑफ एक वास्तविक संभावना है।

segments.src: ## Why it matters for the region
segments.tr: ## यह क्षेत्र के लिए क्यों मायने रखता है

segments.src: Brazil is the largest economy in Latin America and a major producer of agricultural goods, iron ore, oil and other commodities.
segments.tr: ब्राजील लैटिन अमेरिका की सबसे बड़ी अर्थव्यवस्था है और कृषि वस्तुओं, लौह अयस्क, तेल और अन्य वस्तुओं का एक प्रमुख उत्पादक है।

segments.src: It plays a leading role in regional diplomacy and in global discussions on trade and climate.
segments.tr: यह क्षेत्रीय कूटनीति और व्यापार और जलवायु पर वैश्विक चर्चाओं में अग्रणी भूमिका निभाता है।

segments.src: Its policy choices affect neighbors' trade, investment flows and regional cooperation, and its stability influences how international investors view emerging markets more broadly.
segments.tr: इसके नीतिगत विकल्प पड़ोसियों के व्यापार, निवेश प्रवाह और क्षेत्रीय सहयोग को प्रभावित करते हैं, और इसकी स्थिरता यह प्रभावित करती है कि अंतरराष्ट्रीय निवेशक उभरते बाजारों को व्यापक रूप से कैसे देखते हैं।

segments.src: ## What U.S. readers should watch
segments.tr: ## अमेरिकी पाठकों को क्या देखना चाहिए

segments.src: - **Whether there is a runoff.** If no one clears 50 percent on Sunday, the race continues for several more weeks, and uncertainty may linger.
segments.tr: - **क्या रनऑफ है।** यदि रविवार को कोई भी 50 प्रतिशत से अधिक नहीं होता है, तो दौड़ कई और हफ्तों तक जारी रहती है, और अनिश्चितता बनी रह सकती है।

segments.src: - **Congressional results.** A fragmented legislature can limit what any president is able to do.
segments.tr: - **कांग्रेस के परिणाम।** एक खंडित विधायिका किसी भी राष्ट्रपति की क्षमता को सीमित कर सकती है।

segments.src: - **Market reaction.** Moves in the Brazilian real, local stocks and bond yields will signal how investors read the outcome.
segments.tr: - **बाजार की प्रतिक्रिया।** ब्राजीलियाई रियल, स्थानीय शेयरों और बॉन्ड यील्ड में हलचल यह संकेत देगी कि निवेशक परिणाम को कैसे पढ़ते हैं।

segments.src: - **Trade and investment signals.** The U.S. and Brazil are major trading partners, and policy on tariffs, energy, agriculture and technology could shift depending on the winner.
segments.tr: - **व्यापार और निवेश के संकेत।** अमेरिका और ब्राजील प्रमुख व्यापारिक भागीदार हैं, और टैरिफ, ऊर्जा, कृषि और प्रौद्योगिकी पर नीति विजेता के आधार पर बदल सकती है।

segments.src: - **Climate and the Amazon.** Brazil's approach to deforestation and environmental enforcement is closely followed by governments and companies worldwide.
segments.tr: - **जलवायु और अमेज़न।** वनों की कटाई और पर्यावरण प्रवर्तन के प्रति ब्राजील के दृष्टिकोण का दुनिया भर की सरकारों और कंपनियों द्वारा बारीकी से पालन किया जाता है।

segments.src: - **Acceptance of the result.** Observers will pay attention to how candidates, institutions and the public respond to the official count.
segments.tr: - **परिणाम की स्वीकृति।** पर्यवेक्षक इस बात पर ध्यान देंगे कि उम्मीदवार, संस्थान और जनता आधिकारिक गिनती पर कैसे प्रतिक्रिया देते हैं।

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## निष्कर्ष

segments.src: Safety and affordability are the issues voters say they feel most directly, and they are shaping how candidates present themselves.
segments.tr: सुरक्षा और सामर्थ्य वे मुद्दे हैं जिन्हें मतदाता सबसे सीधे महसूस करते हैं, और वे इस बात को आकार दे रहे हैं कि उम्मीदवार खुद को कैसे प्रस्तुत करते हैं।

segments.src: Whatever the result on Sunday, the next government will face pressure to deliver on both while managing a divided country and a cautious investment community.
segments.tr: रविवार को परिणाम चाहे जो भी हो, अगली सरकार को एक विभाजित देश और एक सतर्क निवेश समुदाय का प्रबंधन करते हुए दोनों पर खरा उतरने के दबाव का सामना करना पड़ेगा।

segments.src: For international readers, the key questions are whether the vote is decisive, how smoothly the transition unfolds, and what direction economic policy takes.

segments.tr: ## Cómo funciona la votación

segments.src: Brazil uses a two-round system for the presidency.
segments.tr: Brasil utiliza un sistema de dos rondas para la presidencia.

segments.src: If no candidate wins more than half of the valid votes on Sunday, the top two finishers advance to a runoff, which is traditionally held about four weeks later.
segments.tr: Si ningún candidato gana más de la mitad de los votos válidos el domingo, los dos primeros pasan a una segunda vuelta, que tradicionalmente se celebra unas cuatro semanas después.

segments.src: Voting is compulsory for most adults, so turnout is typically high.
segments.tr: El voto es obligatorio para la mayoría de los adultos, por lo que la participación suele ser alta.

segments.src: Votes are cast on electronic voting machines, and results usually come in quickly on election night.
segments.tr: Los votos se emiten en urnas electrónicas y los resultados suelen llegar rápidamente la noche de las elecciones.

segments.src: Voters are also choosing members of the Chamber of Deputies, a portion of the Senate, state governors and state legislators.
segments.tr: Los votantes también eligen a los miembros de la Cámara de Diputados, una parte del Senado, gobernadores estatales y legisladores estatales.

segments.src: The makeup of Congress matters almost as much as the presidency, because a president needs legislative support to pass budgets, tax changes and reforms.
segments.tr: La composición del Congreso importa casi tanto como la presidencia, porque un presidente necesita apoyo legislativo para aprobar presupuestos, cambios fiscales y reformas.

segments.src: ## The issues driving the race
segments.tr: ## Los temas que impulsan la contienda

segments.src: ### Public safety
segments.tr: ### Seguridad pública

segments.src: Concerns about crime, organized criminal groups and violence have become central to the campaign.
segments.tr: Las preocupaciones sobre el crimen, los grupos criminales organizados y la violencia se han vuelto centrales en la campaña.

segments.src: Voters in many large cities and in several regions report worries about armed gangs, drug trafficking and theft.
segments.tr: Los votantes en muchas grandes ciudades y en varias regiones informan preocupaciones sobre pandillas armadas, narcotráfico y robos.

segments.src: Candidates have offered different answers, from tougher policing and sentencing to investment in intelligence, prisons, border control and social programs.
segments.tr: Los candidatos han ofrecido diferentes respuestas, desde una policia y sentencias más duras hasta inversión en inteligencia, prisiones, control fronterizo y programas sociales.

segments.src: Public safety is largely a state responsibility in Brazil, which means governors' races carry real weight on this issue, even as presidential candidates debate national strategy.
segments.tr: La seguridad pública es en gran medida responsabilidad estatal en Brasil, lo que significa que las elecciones a gobernador tienen un peso real en este tema, incluso mientras los candidatos presidenciales debaten la estrategia nacional.

segments.src: ### Cost of living
segments.tr: ### Costo de vida

segments.src: Prices for food, housing, energy and transportation remain a daily concern for many households.
segments.tr: Los precios de los alimentos, la vivienda, la energía y el transporte siguen siendo una preocupación diaria para muchos hogares.

segments.src: Interest rates have been high as the central bank has worked to keep inflation in check, which raises borrowing costs for families and businesses.
segments.tr: Las tasas de interés han sido altas a medida que el banco central ha trabajado para mantener la inflación bajo control, lo que aumenta los costos de endeudamiento para las familias y las empresas.

segments.src: Voters are weighing which candidates seem most likely to protect purchasing power, create jobs and manage public spending responsibly.
segments.tr: Los votantes están sopesando qué candidatos parecen más propensos a proteger el poder adquisitivo, crear empleos y gestionar el gasto público de manera responsable.

segments.src: ### Fiscal policy and the economy
segments.tr: ### Política fiscal y economía

segments.src: Investors are watching how the next government plans to handle public debt, spending limits and tax reform.
segments.tr: Los inversores están observando cómo el próximo gobierno planea manejar la deuda pública, los límites de gasto y la reforma fiscal.

segments.src: Markets in Brazil have often reacted strongly to signals about fiscal discipline, and the currency, the real, can swing with political news.
segments.tr: Los mercados en Brasil a menudo han reaccionado fuertemente a las señales sobre la disciplina fiscal, y la moneda, el real, puede oscilar con las noticias políticas.

segments.src: Any shift in approach to spending, social programs or state-owned companies could influence growth, inflation and investor confidence.
segments.tr: Cualquier cambio en el enfoque del gasto, los programas sociales o las empresas estatales podría influir en el crecimiento, la inflación y la confianza de los inversores.

segments.src: ### A polarized electorate
segments.tr: ### Un electorado polarizado

segments.src: Brazilian politics has been sharply divided for years, with strong loyalties on both the left and the right.
segments.tr: La política brasileña ha estado fuertemente dividida durante años, con fuertes le tanto en la izquierda como en la derecha.

segments.src: Campaigns have been marked by heated rhetoric, intense social media activity and concerns about misinformation.
segments.tr: Las campañas han estado marcadas por una retórica acalorada, una intensa actividad en las redes sociales y preocupaciones sobre la desinformación.

segments.src: Many analysts note that a sizable group of undecided or less-committed voters could decide close contests, and that a runoff is a real possibility.
segments.tr: Muchos analistas señalan que un grupo considerable de votantes indecisos o menos comprometidos podría decidir contiendas cerradas, y que una segunda vuelta es una posibilidad real.

segments.src: ## Why it matters for the region
segments.tr: ## Por qué importa para la región

segments.src: Brazil is the largest economy in Latin America and a major producer of agricultural goods, iron ore, oil and other commodities.
segments.tr: Brasil es la economía más grande de América Latina y un importante productor de bienes agrícolas, mineral de hierro, petróleo y otros productos básicos.

segments.src: It plays a leading role in regional diplomacy and in global discussions on trade and climate.
segments.tr: Desempeña un papel de liderazgo en la diplomacia regional y en las discusiones globales sobre comercio y clima.

segments.src: Its policy choices affect neighbors' trade, investment flows and regional cooperation, and its stability influences how international investors view emerging markets more broadly.
segments.tr: Sus elecciones de política afectan el comercio de los vecinos, los flujos de inversión y la cooperación regional, y su estabilidad influye en cómo los inversores internacionales ven los mercados emergentes en general.

segments.src: ## What U.S. readers should watch
segments.tr: ## Qué deben observar los lectores de EE. UU.

segments.src: - **Whether there is a runoff.** If no one clears 50 percent on Sunday, the race continues for several more weeks, and uncertainty may linger.
segments.tr: - **Si hay una segunda vuelta.** Si nadie supera el 50 por ciento el domingo, la carrera continúa durante varias semanas más y la incertidumbre puede persistir.

segments.src: - **Congressional results.** A fragmented legislature can limit what any president is able to do.
segments.tr: - **Resultados del Congreso.** Una legislatura fragmentada puede limitar lo que cualquier presidente puede hacer.

segments.src: - **Market reaction.** Moves in the Brazilian real, local stocks and bond yields will signal how investors read the outcome.
segments.tr: - **Reacción del mercado.** Los movimientos en el real brasileño, las acciones locales y los rendimientos de los bonos indicarán cómo los inversores interpretan el resultado.

segments.src: - **Trade and investment signals.** The U.S. and Brazil are major trading partners, and policy on tariffs, energy, agriculture and technology could shift depending on the winner.
segments.tr: - **Señales de comercio e inversión.** EE. UU. y Brasil son socios comerciales importantes, y la política sobre aranceles, energía, agricultura y tecnología podría cambiar dependiendo del ganador.

segments.src: - **Climate and the Amazon.** Brazil's approach to deforestation and environmental enforcement is closely followed by governments and companies worldwide.
segments.tr: - **Clima y el Amazonas.** El enfoque de Brasil hacia la deforestación y la aplicación ambiental es seguido de cerca por gobiernos y empresas de todo el mundo.

segments.src: - **Acceptance of the result.** Observers will pay attention to how candidates, institutions and the public respond to the official count.
segments.tr: - **Aceptación del resultado.** Los observadores prestarán atención a cómo los candidatos, las instituciones y el público responden al recuento oficial.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## El resultado final

segments.src: Safety and affordability are the issues voters say they feel most directly, and they are shaping how candidates present themselves.
segments.tr: La seguridad y la asequibilidad son los temas que los votantes dicen sentir más directamente, y están dando forma a cómo se presentan los candidatos.

segments.src: Whatever the result on Sunday, the next government will face pressure to deliver on both while managing a divided country and a cautious investment community.
segments.tr: Sea cual sea el resultado del domingo, el próximo gobierno enfrentará presión para cumplir con ambos mientras gestiona un país dividido y una comunidad de inversores cautelosa.

segments.src: For international readers, the key questions are whether the vote is decisive, how smoothly the transition unfolds, and what direction economic policy takes.
segments.tr: Para los lectores internacionales, las preguntas clave son si la votación es decisiva, cuán sin problemas se desarrolla la transición y qué dirección toma la política económica.

segments.src: Voting is compulsory for most adults, so turnout is typically high.
segments.tr: Le vote est obligatoire pour la plupart des adultes, la participation est donc généralement élevée.

segments.src: Votes are cast on electronic voting machines, and results usually come in quickly on election night.
segments.tr: Les votes sont effectués sur des urnes électroniques, et les résultats tombent généralement rapidement la nuit du scrutin.

segments.src: Voters are also choosing members of the Chamber of Deputies, a portion of the Senate, state governors and state legislators.
segments.tr: Les électeurs choisissent également les membres de la Chambre des députés, une partie du Sénat, les gouverneurs d'État et les législateurs des États.

segments.src: The makeup of Congress matters almost as much as the presidency, because a president needs legislative support to pass budgets, tax changes and reforms.
segments.tr: La composition du Congrès importe presque autant que la présidence, car un président a besoin du soutien législatif pour adopter les budgets, les modifications fiscales et les réformes.

segments.src: ## The issues driving the race
segments.tr: ## Les enjeux de la campagne

segments.src: ### Public safety
segments.tr: ### Sécurité publique

segments.src: Concerns about crime, organized criminal groups and violence have become central to the campaign.
segments.tr: Les inquiétudes concernant la criminalité, le crime organisé et la violence sont devenues centrales dans la campagne.

segments.src: Voters in many large cities and in several regions report worries about armed gangs, drug trafficking and theft.
segments.tr: Les électeurs de nombreuses grandes villes et de plusieurs régions se disent préoccupés par les gangs armés, le trafic de drogue et les vols.

segments.src: Candidates have offered different answers, from tougher policing and sentencing to investment in intelligence, prisons, border control and social programs.
segments.tr: Les candidats ont proposé différentes réponses, allant d'un maintien de l'ordre et de peines plus fermes à des investissements dans le renseignement, les prisons, le contrôle des frontières et les programmes sociaux.

segments.src: Public safety is largely a state responsibility in Brazil, which means governors' races carry real weight on this issue, even as presidential candidates debate national strategy.
segments.tr: La sécurité publique relève principalement de la responsabilité des États au Brésil, ce qui signifie que les élections des gouverneurs ont un réel poids sur ce sujet, même si les candidats à la présidence débattent de la stratégie nationale.

segments.src: ### Cost of living
segments.tr: ### Coût de la vie

segments.src: Prices for food, housing, energy and transportation remain a daily concern for many households.
segments.tr: Les prix de l'alimentation, du logement, de l'énergie et des transports restent une préoccupation quotidienne pour de nombreux foyers.

segments.src: Interest rates have been high as the central bank has worked to keep inflation in check, which raises borrowing costs for families and businesses.
segments.tr: Les taux d'intérêt sont restés élevés alors que la banque centrale s'efforçait de contenir l'inflation, ce qui augmente le coût de l'emprunt pour les familles et les entreprises.

segments.src: Voters are weighing which candidates seem most likely to protect purchasing power, create jobs and manage public spending responsibly.
segments.tr: Les électeurs évaluent quels candidats semblent les plus à même de protéger le pouvoir d'achat, de créer des emplois et de gérer les dépenses publiques de manière responsable.

segments.src: ### Fiscal policy and the economy
segments.tr: ### Politique budgétaire et économie

segments.src: Investors are watching how the next government plans to handle public debt, spending limits and tax reform.
segments.tr: Les investisseurs observent la manière dont le prochain gouvernement prévoit de gérer la dette publique, le plafonnement des dépenses et la réforme fiscale.

segments.src: Markets in Brazil have often reacted strongly to signals about fiscal discipline, and the currency, the real, can swing with political news.
segments.tr: Les marchés brésiliens ont souvent réagi vivement aux signaux sur la discipline budgétaire, et la monnaie, le real, peut osciller au gré de l'actualité politique.

segments.src: Any shift in approach to spending, social programs or state-owned companies could influence growth, inflation and investor confidence.
segments.tr: Tout changement d'approche concernant les dépenses, les programmes sociaux ou les entreprises publiques pourrait influencer la croissance, l'inflation et la confiance des investisseurs.

segments.src: ### A polarized electorate
segments.tr: ### Un électorat polarisé

segments.src: Brazilian politics has been sharply divided for years, with strong loyalties on both the left and the right.
segments.tr: La politique brésilienne est profondément divisée depuis des années, avec de fortes loyautés à gauche comme à droite.

segments.src: Campaigns have been marked by heated rhetoric, intense social media activity and concerns about misinformation.
segments.tr: Les campagnes ont été marquées par une rhétorique enflammée, une activité intense sur les réseaux sociaux et des inquiétudes concernant la désinformation.

segments.src: Many analysts note that a sizable group of undecided or less-committed voters could decide close contests, and that a runoff is a real possibility.
segments.tr: De nombreux analystes soulignent qu'un groupe important d'électeurs indécis ou moins engagés pourrait faire basculer des判断 serrés, et qu'un second tour est une réelle possibilité.

segments.src: ## Why it matters for the region
segments.tr: ## Pourquoi c'est important pour la région

segments.src: Brazil is the largest economy in Latin America and a major producer of agricultural goods, iron ore, oil and other commodities.
segments.tr: Le Brésil est la plus grande économie d'Amérique latine et un producteur majeur de produits agricoles, de minerai de fer, de pétrole et d'autres matières premières.

segments.src: It plays a leading role in regional diplomacy and in global discussions on trade and climate.
segments.tr: Il joue un rôle de premier plan dans la diplomatie régionale et dans les discussions mondiales sur le commerce et le climat.

segments.src: Its policy choices affect neighbors' trade, investment flows and regional cooperation, and its stability influences how international investors view emerging markets more broadly.
segments.tr: Ses choix politiques affectent le commerce de ses voisins, les flux d'investissement et la coopération régionale, et sa stabilité influence la façon dont les investisseurs internationaux perçoivent plus largement les marchés émergents.

segments.src: ## What U.S. readers should watch
segments.tr: ## Ce que les lecteurs américains doivent surveiller

segments.src: - **Whether there is a runoff.** If no one clears 50 percent on Sunday, the race continues for several more weeks, and uncertainty may linger.
segments.tr: - **S'il y aura un second tour.** Si personne ne dépasse les 50 % dimanche, la course se poursuivra pendant plusieurs semaines et l'incertitude pourrait persister.

segments.src: - **Congressional results.** A fragmented legislature can limit what any president is able to do.
segments.tr: - **Les résultats législatifs.** Un Congrès fragmenté peut limiter la marge de manœuvre de n'importe quel président.

segments.src: - **Market reaction.** Moves in the Brazilian real, local stocks and bond yields will signal how investors read the outcome.
segments.tr: - **La réaction des marchés.** Les mouvements du real brésilien, des actions locales et des rendements obligataires indiqueront comment les investisseurs interprètent le résultat.

segments.src: - **Trade and investment signals.** The U.S. and Brazil are major trading partners, and policy on tariffs, energy, agriculture and technology could shift depending on the winner.
segments.tr: - **Les signaux sur le commerce et l'investissement.** Les États-Unis et le Brésil sont des partenaires commerciaux majeurs, et les politiques sur les droits de douane, l'énergie, l'agriculture et la technologie pourraient évoluer selon le vainqueur.

segments.src: - **Climate and the Amazon.** Brazil's approach to deforestation and environmental enforcement is closely followed by governments and companies worldwide.
segments.tr: - **Le climat et l'Amazonie.** L'approche du Brésil en matière de déforestation et d'application des lois environnementales est suivie de près par les gouvernements et les entreprises du monde entier.

segments.src: - **Acceptance of the result.** Observers will pay attention to how candidates, institutions and the public respond to the official count.
segments.tr: - **L'acceptation du résultat.** Les observateurs prêteront attention à la manière dont les candidats, les institutions et le public réagiront au décompte officiel.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## En résumé

segments.src: Safety and affordability are the issues voters say they feel most directly, and they are shaping how candidates present themselves.
segments.tr: La sécurité et l'accessibilité financière sont les enjeux que les électeurs disent ressentir le plus directement, et ils façonnent la façon dont les candidats se présentent.

segments.src: Whatever the result on Sunday, the next government will face pressure to deliver on both while managing a divided country and a cautious investment community.
segments.tr: Quel que soit le résultat de dimanche, le prochain gouvernement devra faire face à la pression d'obtenir des résultats sur ces deux fronts tout en gérant un pays divisé et une communauté d'investisseurs prudente.

segments.src: For international readers, the key questions are whether the vote is decisive, how smoothly the transition unfolds, and what direction economic policy takes.
segments.tr: Pour les lecteurs internationaux, les questions clés sont de savoir si le vote sera décisif, à quel point la transition se déroulera sans heurt et quelle direction prendra la politique économique.

pt.title: Crime, Custo de Vida e um Eleitorado Polarizado: O que Observar nas Eleições Brasileiras de Domingo

segments.src: Brazilians head to the polls on Sunday, October 4, in national elections that will decide the presidency, seats in Congress and many state governorships.
segments.tr: Os brasileiros vão às urnas no domingo, 4 de outubro, em eleições nacionais que decidirão a presidência, cadeiras no Congresso e muitos governos estaduais.

segments.src: Public safety sits near the top of voters' concerns in recent polling, alongside the cost of living and a deeply divided political climate.
segments.tr: A segurança pública está entre as principais preocupações dos eleitores em pesquisas recentes, juntamente com o custo de vida e um clima político profundamente dividido.

segments.src: For Latin America's largest economy, the outcome will shape policy for the next four years, and the effects will reach well beyond its borders.
segments.tr: Para a maior economia da América Latina, o resultado moldará a política pelos próximos quatro anos, e os efeitos alcançarão muito além de suas fronteiras.

segments.src: ## How the vote works

segments.src: Brazil uses a two-round system for the presidency.
segments.tr: O Brasil utiliza um sistema de dois turnos para a presidência.

segments.src: If no candidate wins more than half of the valid votes on Sunday, the top two finishers advance to a runoff, which is traditionally held about four weeks later.
segments.tr: Se nenhum candidato obtiver mais da metade dos votos válidos no domingo, os dois mais votados avançam para um segundo turno, que é tradicionalmente realizado cerca de quatro semanas depois.

segments.src: Voting is compulsory for most adults, so turnout is typically high.
segments.tr: O voto é obrigatório para a maioria dos adultos, portanto, a participação é geralmente alta.

segments.src: Votes are cast on electronic voting machines, and results usually come in quickly on election night.
segments.tr: Os votos são computados em urnas eletrônicas, e os resultados geralmente saem rapidamente na noite da eleição.

segments.src: Voters are also choosing members of the Chamber of Deputies, a portion of the Senate, state governors and state legislators.
segments.tr: Os eleitores também estão escolhendo membros da Câmara dos Deputados, uma parte do Senado, governadores estaduais e legisladores estaduais.

segments.src: The makeup of Congress matters almost as much as the presidency, because a president needs legislative support to pass budgets, tax changes and reforms.

segments.src: ## The issues driving the race

segments.src: Candidates have offered different answers, from tougher policing and sentencing to investment in intelligence, prisons, border control and social programs.

segments.src: ### Cost of living
segments.tr: ### Custo de vida

segments.src: Interest rates have been high as the central bank has worked to keep inflation in check, which raises borrowing costs for families and businesses.
segments.tr: As taxas de juros têm estado altas, já que o banco central tem trabalhado para manter a inflação sob controle, o que aumenta os custos de empréstimos para famílias e empresas.

segments.src: Voters are weighing which candidates seem most likely to protect purchasing power, create jobs and manage public spending responsibly.
segments.tr: Os eleitores estão avaliando quais candidatos parecem mais propensos a proteger o poder de compra, criar empregos e gerenciar os gastos públicos de forma responsável.

segments.src: ### Fiscal policy and the economy
segments.tr: ### Política fiscal e a economia

segments.src: Investors are watching how the next government plans to handle public debt, spending limits and tax reform.
segments.tr: Os investidores estão observando como o próximo governo planeja lidar com a dívida pública, limites de gastos e reforma tributária.

segments.src: Markets in Brazil have often reacted strongly to signals about fiscal discipline, and the currency, the real, can swing with political news.

segments.src: Any shift in approach to spending, social programs or state-owned companies could influence growth, inflation and investor confidence.
segments.tr: Qualquer mudança na abordagem aos gastos, programas sociais ou empresas estatais pode influenciar o crescimento, a inflação e a confiança dos investidores.

segments.src: ### A polarized electorate
segments.tr: ### Um eleitorado polarizado

ja.title: 犯罪、生活費、そして二極化した有権者：日曜日のブラジル選挙で注目すべき点

segments.src: Brazilians head to the polls on Sunday, October 4, in national elections that will decide the presidency, seats in Congress and many state governorships.
segments.tr: ブラジル国民は10月4日（日）、大統領、連邦議会議員、そして多くの州知事を選出する国政選挙の投票に向かう。

segments.src: Public safety sits near the top of voters' concerns in recent polling, alongside the cost of living and a deeply divided political climate.
segments.tr: 最近の世論調査では、生活費や深く分断された政治情勢と並び、治安が有権者の最大の関心事の一つとなっている。

segments.src: For Latin America's largest economy, the outcome will shape policy for the next four years, and the effects will reach well beyond its borders.
segments.tr: ラテンアメリカ最大の経済大国にとって、この選挙結果は今後4年間の政策を決定づけるものであり、その影響は国境を越えて広がるだろう。

segments.src: ## How the vote works
segments.tr: ## 投票の仕組み

segments.src: Brazil uses a two-round system for the presidency.
segments.tr: ブラジルの大統領選挙は二回投票制を採用している。

segments.src: If no candidate wins more than half of the valid votes on Sunday, the top two finishers advance to a runoff, which is traditionally held about four weeks later.
segments.tr: 日曜日の投票で過半数の有効票を獲得した候補者がいない場合、上位2名による決選投票が行われる。これは通常、約4週間後に行われる。

segments.src: Voting is compulsory for most adults, so turnout is typically high.
segments.tr: ほとんどの成人にとって投票は義務であるため、投票率は通常高い。

segments.src: Votes are cast on electronic voting machines, and results usually come in quickly on election night.
segments.tr: 投票は電子投票機で行われ、結果は通常、選挙当日の夜に迅速に判明する。

segments.src: Voters are also choosing members of the Chamber of Deputies, a portion of the Senate, state governors and state legislators.
segments.tr: 有権者は同時に、下院議員、上院議員の一部、州知事、州議会議員も選出する。

segments.src: The makeup of Congress matters almost as much as the presidency, because a president needs legislative support to pass budgets, tax changes and reforms.
segments.tr: 議会の構成は大統領職とほぼ同等に重要である。なぜなら、大統領が予算、税制改正、改革を可決させるには議会の支持が必要だからである。

segments.src: ## The issues driving the race
segments.tr: ## 選挙戦を左右する争点

segments.src: ### Public safety
segments.tr: ### 公共の安全

segments.src: Concerns about crime, organized criminal groups and violence have become central to the campaign.
segments.tr: 犯罪、組織犯罪グループ、暴力に対する懸念が選挙戦の中心となっている。

segments.src: Voters in many large cities and in several regions report worries about armed gangs, drug trafficking and theft.
segments.tr: 多くの大都市やいくつかの地域では、武装ギャング、麻薬密売、窃盗に対する不安が報告されている。

segments.src: Candidates have offered different answers, from tougher policing and sentencing to investment in intelligence, prisons, border control and social programs.
segments.tr: 候補者は、警察の強化や厳罰化から、情報収集、刑務所、国境管理、社会プログラムへの投資に至るまで、それぞれ異なる回答を提示している。

segments.src: Public safety is largely a state responsibility in Brazil, which means governors' races carry real weight on this issue, even as presidential candidates debate national strategy.
segments.tr: ブラジルにおいて公共の安全は主に州の責任であるため、大統領候補が国家戦略を議論する一方で、州知事選はこの問題において実質的な重みを持っている。

segments.src: ### Cost of living
segments.tr: ### 生活費

segments.src: Prices for food, housing, energy and transportation remain a daily concern for many households.
segments.tr: 食料、住宅、エネルギー、交通費の価格は、多くの家庭にとって日々の懸念事項であり続けている。

segments.src: Interest rates have been high as the central bank has worked to keep inflation in check, which raises borrowing costs for families and businesses.
segments.tr: 中央銀行がインフレ抑制に取り組んでいるため金利は高止まりしており、これが家計や企業の借入コストを押し上げている。

segments.src: Voters are weighing which candidates seem most likely to protect purchasing power, create jobs and manage public spending responsibly.
segments.tr: 有権者は、どの候補者が購買力を守り、雇用を創出し、公共支出を責任を持って管理できそうかを比較検討している。

segments.src: ### Fiscal policy and the economy
segments.tr: ### 財政政策と経済

segments.src: Investors are watching how the next government plans to handle public debt, spending limits and tax reform.
segments.tr: 投資家は、次期政権が公的債務、支出制限、税制改革にどう取り組むかを注視している。

segments.src: Markets in Brazil have often reacted strongly to signals about fiscal discipline, and the currency, the real, can swing with political news.
segments.tr: ブラジルの市場は財政規律に関するシグナルに敏感に反応することが多く、通貨レアルは政治ニュースによって変動する可能性がある。

segments.src: Any shift in approach to spending, social programs or state-owned companies could influence growth, inflation and investor confidence.
segments.tr: 支出、社会プログラム、国有企業に対するアプローチの変化は、成長、インフレ、投資家の信頼に影響を与える可能性がある。

segments.src: ### A polarized electorate
segments.tr: ### 二極化した有権者

segments.tr: ブラジルの政治は何年にもわたって鋭く分断されており、左派と右派の双方に強い忠誠心が存在する。

segments.src: It plays a leading role in regional diplomacy and in global discussions on trade and climate.
segments.tr: Es spielt eine führende Rolle in der regionalen Diplomatie und bei globalen Gesprächen über Handel und Klima.

segments.src: Its policy choices affect neighbors' trade, investment flows and regional cooperation, and its stability influences how international investors view emerging markets more broadly.
segments.tr: Seine politischen Entscheidungen beeinflussen den Handel der Nachbarländer, Investitionsflüsse und die regionale Zusammenarbeit, und seine Stabilität beeinflusst, wie internationale Investoren Schwellenländer im Allgemeinen wahrnehmen.

segments.src: ## What U.S. readers should watch
segments.tr: ## Worauf US-Leser achten sollten

segments.src: - **Whether there is a runoff.** If no one clears 50 percent on Sunday, the race continues for several more weeks, and uncertainty may linger.
segments.tr: - **Ob es zu einer Stichwahl kommt.** Wenn am Sonntag niemand die 50-Prozent-Hürde nimmt, setzt sich das Rennen noch einige Wochen fort, und die Unsicherheit könnte anhalten.

segments.src: - **Congressional results.** A fragmented legislature can limit what any president is able to do.
segments.tr: - **Ergebnisse der Kongresswahl.** Ein fragmentiertes Parlament kann die Handlungsfähigkeit jedes Präsidenten einschränken.

segments.src: - **Market reaction.** Moves in the Brazilian real, local stocks and bond yields will signal how investors read the outcome.
segments.tr: - **Marktreaktion.** Bewegungen beim brasilianischen Real, lokalen Aktien und Anleiherenditen werden signalisieren, wie Investoren das Ergebnis deuten.

segments.src: - **Trade and investment signals.** The U.S. and Brazil are major trading partners, and policy on tariffs, energy, agriculture and technology could shift depending on the winner.
segments.tr: - **Handels- und Investitionssignale.** Die USA und Brasilien sind wichtige Handelspartner, und die Politik in Bezug auf Zölle, Energie, Landwirtschaft und Technologie könnte sich je nach Sieger verschieben.

segments.src: - **Climate and the Amazon.** Brazil's approach to deforestation and environmental enforcement is closely followed by governments and companies worldwide.
segments.tr: - **Klima und der Amazonas.** Brasiliens Ansatz bei der Entwaldung und dem Durchsetzen von Umweltbestimmungen wird von Regierungen und Unternehmen weltweit aufmerksam verfolgt.

segments.src: - **Acceptance of the result.** Observers will pay attention to how candidates, institutions and the public respond to the official count.
segments.tr: - **Akzeptanz des Ergebnisses.** Beobachter werden darauf achten, wie Kandidaten, Institutionen und die Öffentlichkeit auf das offizielle Auszählungsergebnis reagieren.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## Das Fazit

segments.src: Safety and affordability are the issues voters say they feel most directly, and they are shaping how candidates present themselves.
segments.tr: Sicherheit und Bezahlbarkeit sind die Themen, die die Wähler nach eigenen Angaben am direktesten spüren, und sie prägen das Auftreten der Kandidaten.

segments.src: Whatever the result on Sunday, the next government will face pressure to deliver on both while managing a divided country and a cautious investment community.
segments.tr: Wie auch immer das Ergebnis am Sonntag ausfällt, die nächste Regierung wird unter Druck stehen, bei beiden Themen Ergebnisse zu liefern und gleichzeitig ein gespaltenes Land und eine vorsichtige Investorengemeinschaft zu steuern.

segments.src: For international readers, the key questions are whether the vote is decisive, how smoothly the transition unfolds, and what direction economic policy takes.
segments.tr: Für internationale Leser sind die entscheidenden Fragen, ob die Wahl eindeutig ist, wie reibungslos der Übergang verläuft und welche Richtung die Wirtschaftspolitik einschlägt.

vi.title: Tội phạm, Chi phí Sinh hoạt và Cử tri Phân cực: Những gì Cần Theo dõi khi Brazil Bỏ phiếu vào Chủ nhật

segments.src: Brazilians head to the polls on Sunday, October 4, in national elections that will decide the presidency, seats in Congress and many state governorships.
segments.tr: Người Brazil sẽ đi bỏ phiếu vào Chủ nhật, ngày 4 tháng 10, trong cuộc tổng tuyển cử quyết định chức tổng thống, các ghế trong Quốc hội và nhiều chức vụ thống đốc bang.

segments.src: Public safety sits near the top of voters' concerns in recent polling, alongside the cost of living and a deeply divided political climate.
segments.tr: An toàn công cộng nằm ở vị trí hàng đầu trong các mối quan tâm của cử tri trong các cuộc thăm dò gần đây, bên cạnh chi phí sinh hoạt và bầu không khí chính trị bị chia rẽ sâu sắc.

segments.src: For Latin America's largest economy, the outcome will shape policy for the next four years, and the effects will reach well beyond its borders.
segments.tr: Đối với nền kinh tế lớn nhất Mỹ Latinh, kết quả sẽ định hình chính sách trong bốn năm tới, và các tác động sẽ vươn xa ra ngoài biên giới nước này.

segments.src: *This article is a general overview for readers.
segments.tr: *Bài viết này là tổng quan chung dành cho độc giả.

segments.src: Check official sources and reputable news outlets for the latest candidate lists, polling and results.*
segments.tr: Hãy kiểm tra các nguồn chính thức và các hãng tin uy tín để biết danh sách ứng cử viên, kết quả thăm dò và kết quả mới nhất.*

segments.src: ## How the vote works
segments.tr: ## Cách thức cuộc bầu cử diễn ra

segments.src: Brazil uses a two-round system for the presidency.
segments.tr: Brazil sử dụng hệ thống hai vòng đối với chức vụ tổng thống.

segments.src: If no candidate wins more than half of the valid votes on Sunday, the top two finishers advance to a runoff, which is traditionally held about four weeks later.
segments.tr: Nếu không có ứng cử viên nào giành được hơn một nửa số phiếu hợp lệ vào Chủ nhật, hai ứng cử viên dẫn đầu sẽ bước vào vòng bầu cử thứ hai, thường được tổ chức khoảng bốn tuần sau đó.

segments.src: Voting is compulsory for most adults, so turnout is typically high.
segments.tr: Bỏ phiếu là nghĩa vụ bắt buộc đối với hầu hết người trưởng thành, do đó tỷ lệ cử tri đi bỏ phiếu thường rất cao.

segments.src: Votes are cast on electronic voting machines, and results usually come in quickly on election night.
segments.tr: Các lá phiếu được bỏ trên máy bỏ phiếu điện tử và kết quả thường có rất nhanh vào đêm bầu cử.

segments.src: Voters are also choosing members of the Chamber of Deputies, a portion of the Senate, state governors and state legislators.
segments.tr: Cử tri cũng đang bầu chọn các thành viên Hạ viện, một phần Thượng viện, các thống đốc bang và các nhà lập pháp bang.

segments.src: The makeup of Congress matters almost as much as the presidency, because a president needs legislative support to pass budgets, tax changes and reforms.
segments.tr: Cấu thành của Quốc hội có tầm quan trọng gần như tương đương với chức vụ tổng thống, bởi vì một tổng thống cần sự hậu thuẫn từ cơ quan lập pháp để thông qua các ngân sách, thay đổi thuế và các cải cách.

segments.src: ## The issues driving the race
segments.tr: ## Các vấn đề thúc đẩy cuộc đua

segments.src: ### Public safety
segments.tr: ### An toàn công cộng

segments.src: Concerns about crime, organized criminal groups and violence have become central to the campaign.
segments.tr: Những lo ngại về tội phạm, các nhóm tội phạm có tổ chức và bạo lực đã trở thành trung tâm của chiến dịch tranh cử.

segments.src: Voters in many large cities and in several regions report worries about armed gangs, drug trafficking and theft.
segments.tr: Cử tri ở nhiều thành phố lớn và ở một số khu vực báo cáo sự lo lắng về các băng đảng có vũ trang, buôn bán ma túy và trộm cắp.

segments.src: Candidates have offered different answers, from tougher policing and sentencing to investment in intelligence, prisons, border control and social programs.
segments.tr: Các ứng cử viên đã đưa ra những câu trả lời khác nhau, từ việc siết chặt trị an và hình phạt cho đến đầu tư vào tình báo, nhà tù, kiểm soát biên giới và các chương trình xã hội.

segments.src: Public safety is largely a state responsibility in Brazil, which means governors' races carry real weight on this issue, even as presidential candidates debate national strategy.
segments.tr: An toàn công cộng phần lớn là trách nhiệm của cấp bang ở Brazil, điều này có nghĩa là các cuộc đua vào ghế thống đốc mang trọng lượng thực sự đối với vấn đề này, ngay cả khi các ứng cử viên tổng thống tranh luận về chiến lược quốc gia.

segments.src: ### Cost of living
segments.tr: ### Chi phí sinh hoạt

segments.src: Prices for food, housing, energy and transportation remain a daily concern for many households.
segments.tr: Giá thực phẩm, nhà ở, năng lượng và giao thông vẫn là mối quan tâm hàng ngày của nhiều hộ gia đình.

segments.src: Interest rates have been high as the central bank has worked to keep inflation in check, which raises borrowing costs for families and businesses.
segments.tr: Lãi suất vẫn duy trì ở mức cao khi ngân hàng trung ương nỗ lực kiềm chế lạm phát, điều này làm tăng chi phí đi vay cho các gia đình và doanh nghiệp.

segments.src: Voters are weighing which candidates seem most likely to protect purchasing power, create jobs and manage public spending responsibly.
segments.tr: Cử tri đang cân nhắc xem ứng cử viên nào có vẻ có khả năng bảo vệ sức mua, tạo việc làm và quản lý chi tiêu công một cách có trách nhiệm nhất.

segments.src: ### Fiscal policy and the economy
segments.tr: ### Chính sách tài khóa và nền kinh tế

segments.src: Investors are watching how the next government plans to handle public debt, spending limits and tax reform.
segments.tr: Các nhà đầu tư đang theo dõi cách chính phủ tiếp theo dự tính xử lý nợ công, giới hạn chi tiêu và cải cách thuế.

segments.src: Markets in Brazil have often reacted strongly to signals about fiscal discipline, and the currency, the real, can swing with political news.
segments.tr: Thị trường tại Brazil thường phản ứng mạnh mẽ với các tín hiệu về kỷ luật tài khóa, và đồng tiền, đồng real, có thể biến động theo các tin tức chính trị.

segments.src: Any shift in approach to spending, social programs or state-owned companies could influence growth, inflation and investor confidence.
segments.tr: Bất kỳ sự thay đổi nào trong cách tiếp cận chi tiêu, các chương trình xã hội hoặc các công ty nhà nước đều có thể ảnh hưởng đến tăng trưởng, lạm phát và niềm tin của nhà đầu tư.

segments.src: ### A polarized electorate
segments.tr: ### Cử tri bị phân cực

segments.src: Brazilian politics has been sharply divided for years, with strong loyalties on both the left and the right.
segments.tr: Chính trị Brazil đã bị chia rẽ sâu sắc trong nhiều năm, với lòng trung thành mạnh mẽ ở cả phe tả lẫn phe hữu.

segments.src: Campaigns have been marked by heated rhetoric, intense social media activity and concerns about misinformation.
segments.tr: Các chiến dịch tranh cử bị đánh dấu bởi những lời lẽ gay gắt, hoạt động truyền thông xã hội cường độ cao và những lo ngại về thông tin sai lệch.

segments.src: Many analysts note that a sizable group of undecided or less-committed voters could decide close contests, and that a runoff is a real possibility.
segments.tr: Nhiều nhà phân tích lưu ý rằng một nhóm lớn cử tri chưa quyết định hoặc ít cam kết hơn có thể quyết định các cuộc thi đấu sít sao, và việc diễn ra vòng hai là một khả năng hoàn toàn có thực.

segments.src: ## Why it matters for the region
segments.tr: ## Tại sao điều đó quan trọng đối với khu vực

segments.src: Brazil is the largest economy in Latin America and a major producer of agricultural goods, iron ore, oil and other commodities.
segments.tr: Brazil là nền kinh tế lớn nhất ở Mỹ Latinh và là nhà sản xuất lớn về hàng hóa nông nghiệp, quặng sắt, dầu mỏ và các mặt hàng cơ bản khác.

segments.src: It plays a leading role in regional diplomacy and in global discussions on trade and climate.
segments.tr: Nước này đóng vai trò lãnh đạo trong ngoại giao khu vực và trong các cuộc thảo luận toàn cầu về thương mại và khí hậu.

segments.src: Its policy choices affect neighbors' trade, investment flows and regional cooperation, and its stability influences how international investors view emerging markets more broadly.
segments.tr: Các lựa chọn chính sách của Brazil ảnh hưởng đến thương mại, dòng vốn đầu tư và hợp tác khu vực của các nước láng giềng, và sự ổn định của nước này ảnh hưởng đến cách các nhà đầu tư quốc tế nhìn nhận các thị trường mới nổi nói chung.

segments.tr: ## Những gì độc giả Hoa Kỳ nên theo dõi

segments.tr: - **Liệu có vòng bầu cử thứ hai hay không.** Nếu không ai đạt được 50 phần trăm vào Chủ nhật, cuộc đua sẽ tiếp tục trong vài tuần nữa và sự bất định có thể kéo dài.

segments.tr: - **Kết quả bầu cử quốc hội.** Một cơ quan lập pháp bị phân mảnh có thể hạn chế những gì một tổng thống có thể làm.

segments.src: - **Market reaction.** Moves in the Brazilian real, local stocks and bond yields will signal how investors read the outcome.
segments.tr: - **Phản ứng của thị trường.** Những biến động của đồng real Brazil, chứng khọn địa phương và lợi suất trái phiếu sẽ báo hiệu cách các nhà đầu tư đánh giá kết quả.

segments.src: - **Trade and investment signals.** The U.S. and Brazil are major trading partners, and policy on tariffs, energy, agriculture and technology could shift depending on the winner.
segments.tr: - **Tín hiệu thương mại và đầu tư.** Hoa Kỳ và Brazil là các đối tác thương mại lớn, và chính sách về thuế quan, năng lượng, nông nghiệp và công nghệ có thể thay đổi tùy theo người chiến thắng.

segments.src: - **Climate and the Amazon.** Brazil's approach to deforestation and environmental enforcement is closely followed by governments and companies worldwide.
segments.tr: - **Khí hậu và Rừng Amazon.** Cách tiếp cận của Brazil đối với nạn phá rừng và thực thi môi trường được theo dõi chặt chẽ bởi các chính phủ và công ty trên toàn thế giới.

segments.src: - **Acceptance of the result.** Observers will pay attention to how candidates, institutions and the public respond to the official count.
segments.tr: - **Sự công nhận kết quả.** Các nhà quan sát sẽ chú ý đến cách các ứng cử viên, các thể chế và công chúng phản ứng với kết quả kiểm phiếu chính thức.

segments.tr: ## Điểm mấu chốt

segments.tr: An toàn và khả năng chi trả là những vấn đề mà cử tri cho biết họ cảm nhận trực tiếp nhất, và chúng đang định hình cách các ứng cử viên thể hiện bản thân.
